statement: Every accept MUST respond to exactly the propose (its prior is the propose alone), name the same subject, and be filed by an actor other than the proposer.

decisions.because: Counterexample to the first draft's witness: an accept whose prior names an offer left out of the bundle was expected to refuse as PROFILE_PRIOR; warrant refuses it first ('prior … not in store'). The profile rule is narrowed to what warrant does not check: an accept whose prior is another record in the bundle (an accept of an accept).
